wiki_text: Map Ta Phut LNG Terminal 3 (also called the Nong Fab LNG Terminal 3 or MTP3) is being developed by Gulf MTP LNG Terminal Co Ltd, a joint venture of Gulf Energy Development PCL (70%) and PTT Tank Terminal Co Ltd, a PTT subsidiary (30%). FID was reached in April 2025 and a ~THB 60 billion (~US$1.83bn) capital increase for the project was approved at Gulf's EGM in June 2025. An EPCC contract for the terminal's superstructure was signed 1 July 2025 with a consortium of POSCO E&C and CAZ (Thai contractor); land-reclamation substructure work was already complete by March 2025. The terminal is being built in two phases (Phase I ~5 mtpa, Phase II expansion to a combined ~10.8 mtpa); commercial operations are targeted for 2029.

topic: Capacity split ambiguity (Phase I vs Phase II)
wiki_text: GEM records MTP3 capacity as Phase I 5.0 mtpa + Phase II 5.8 mtpa = 10.8 mtpa total. Reuters (2019) and LNG Prime (2025) both cite an initial ~5 mtpa figure consistent with GEM's Phase I value, but several July-2025 EPCC-signing articles (Offshore Energy, Enerdata, KED Global) instead describe an '8 mtpa' terminal -- the discrepancy is unresolved as of this 2026-07-27 re-verification. It is possible the 8-mtpa figure describes the capacity of the EPCC-contracted construction package rather than either individual GEM phase; it is NOT clearly a contradiction of the 10.8 mtpa full-build total, which is corroborated across sources. Flagged in qa for a human reconciliation pass against primary FID/EGM documents if available.
